Distribution

Welcome to DynamiaTools

You are running the minimal distribution JAR. This lightweight build wires the core platform but purposely avoids demo data so you control what loads.

What now?

  1. Create your first entity + CRUD: ./dynamia new-module contacts then follow README steps.
  2. Add a navigation module provider (see HomeModuleProvider source) to register pages.
  3. Define form/table descriptors under META-INF/descriptors for dynamic CRUD UIs.

Why this page?

Previously the UI appeared blank because no modules/pages were registered. This embedded page serves as a visual confirmation the framework booted correctly.

Next Tip: Run ./dynamia demo to launch the fuller example application with sample CRUD pages.
